bibl.title: Nuovi scolii a Demostene in P. Lond. Lit. 25 (Dem. XXV.41-42, 43, 63-67)
bibl.seg: Lorenzo Sardone, Nuovi scolii a Demostene in P. Lond. Lit. 25 (Dem. XXV.41-42, 43, 63-67).
bibl.note: 1. Il supporto e la ricostruzione codicologica. - 2. La scrittura, la punteggiatura e le correzioni. - 3. L'apparato scoliastico. - 4. Il testo.The fragments that constitute P. lit. Lond. 125 (= MP3 325; LDAB 755) are all that remains of a codex written in the Vp century, that reports chapters from Demosthenes' Against Aristogeiton (XXV). This re-edition allows the reading of new portions of the speech and the identification of five marginal scholia. Despite the deterioration of the parchment and the faded ink, the photo reconstruction gives an idea of the preciousness of this ancient book.
